parent_authorization: Bounded post-hoc CPU attribution: stable mean CE versus paired worst-endpoint CE in logit-mean architecture.
scope: After observing earlier development results; both backbones fixed together; zero new forwards/generation/confirmation reads.
architecture: Frozen per-vector RMS normalized 2x4096 hidden states, zero initialized 5x4096 residual with original code logits; reorder each mapping into native semantics, average logits, then log_softmax.

training.head: zero initialized 5x4096 residual, no bias; per-vector RMS normalization
training.selection: minimum dev native NLL separately within each loss, no confirmation selection

mean_loss: Stable endpoint NLL, same learned_group-balanced mean as original CE.
worst_loss: Each (unit_id,pair_task) task group: maximum of endpoints own-gold stable NLL. Then mean over tasks in unit, units in learned_group, and learned_groups. Strong/weak controls keep each endpoint own gold; no output-equality penalty. Torch amax distributes gradients equally for exact ties.
selection: Minimum original dev learned_group-balanced mean NLL, not paired correctness or worst loss; separately within each arm, include epoch0.
numerical_check: Record old clamped and stable gradients for all initial losses below 1e-12, including known M5 s024798; compare stable mean fit with existing clamped logit CE.
not_claimed: No originality/GroupDRO claim, no complete native output evaluation, no adoption without both-backbone and strong-control evidence.
